fields.sections.0.ko: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, which plays a different role from deep reasoning models like Carbon and Argon. Hydrogen is designed for fast execution of everyday coding tasks and agent workflows, and is open to all user tiers: Google AI Studio, Gemini API, business versions, Gemini app, and Google Search. Pricing is fixed at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, with uniform pricing across the entire context window.
fields.sections.1.ko: Hydrogen surpasses Argon (50) at the basic high-thinking level on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. More significantly, it shows marked improvement over Gemini 3.8 Flash, tripling the score on Terminal-Bench 4.1 (57% vs 18.2%), and reducing false information by over fivefold. It has also improved its ability to adapt to tool-call failures and search gaps.
fields.sections.2.ko: In software development, Carbon and Argon are used for complex architecture decisions and subtle bug fixes, but fast and disciplined models are needed for code writing, testing, and change verification. Hydrogen can handle these everyday tasks independently or serve as a high-efficiency execution engine alongside frontier models. Google Antigravity's new Orchestrator feature dynamically switches between Carbon and Hydrogen within the same session, achieving Carbon-level success rates while reducing token usage by 24% and execution time by 19%.
fields.sections.3.ko: In repository coding and debugging, Hydrogen discovers and fixes bugs through focused edits without damaging existing code, outperforming competing models on the SWE-sweep benchmark. By processing multiple files in parallel batches rather than sequentially, it achieved 12–23% reduction in token usage and 2–2.8x faster processing on complex repositories. On multi-step tasks (research, data analysis, codebase exploration), it ranked 5th on Agent Arena, and on multimodal tasks (PDFs, spreadsheets, charts, audio combined), it recorded 53.4% on the new MKA benchmark.
fields.sections.4.ko: Hydrogen generates more polished layouts with fewer prompts on speed-critical tasks like UI prototyping, design-to-code iteration, and interactive app development. In a real example, Geminisland generated 3D structures on a shared voxel island with a single prompt, and alongside Google Antigravity's frontend design technology, completed an e-commerce store with WebGL2 shaders, scroll animations, and 3D specification cards in one go. It also performed various multimodal tasks such as transforming Google Sheets into an animated canvas or auto-generating Google Slides presentations based on YouTube videos.
fields.sections.5.ko: Hydrogen offers four thinking levels (low, medium, high, ultra-high), designed so that you only wait and pay for the depth of reasoning your task requires. These tiers show smooth and predictable progression in quality, latency, and cost. In the consumer Gemini app, it results in better instruction adherence, tool calling, and reliable results, and on everyday tasks like emails, reports, and learning materials, it delivers usable results from the first attempt.
fields.sections.6.ko: Hydrogen significantly upgrades Google Search, better understanding natural thought flows, multi-step questions, typos, and specific requests. It delivers visually scannable adaptive responses at search speed, and uses query expansion techniques with advanced reasoning to connect users to sites they previously hadn't discovered.
fields.sections.7.ko: Hydrogen brings the latest Gemini 4 safety and security stack to a broad user base, combining built-in training and real-time safeguards. In agent tasks, it reduced over-reach by up to 81% and under-service by up to 79%, and reduced misalignment and shortcut behavior by 12x in tool use and coding evaluation. When facing impossible or blocked tasks, the probability of bypassing permission boundaries is 2x lower, and it achieved 94% honesty in internal validation. It also maintains 99.9% chain-of-thought traceability while recording zero instances of deceptive reasoning edits, and is 2.3x more resilient against Gray Swan indirect prompt injection attacks.
fields.sections.8.ko: Hydrogen is tuned to make everyday conversations more reliable and safe across all Google product surfaces. Improved safeguards more accurately distinguish real biosecurity risks from legitimate medical and scientific questions, maintaining a false rejection rate below 0.4% on HealthBench Pro.
fields.sections.9.ko: Hydrogen is launching immediately across all tiers: developers (Gemini API, AI Studio, Android Studio), enterprises (Gemini for business, Google Sheets), and consumers (Gemini app, Google Search). Paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers also have access via Google Antigravity, and free Gemini app users will have access to Hydrogen as well.
fields.caveat: Performance figures and benchmarks are based on Google's internal testing and public benchmark results, so actual performance in production environments may vary depending on tasks and datasets, and independent validation is necessary.
